craft_notes: Sthāyin: permission (let all be). Rows: row 2 (create→rest). Close: not (na paśyāmi kim: what do I NOT see — negation as landing). Rejected: 'detachment' — killed: let-be kept (permission, not withdrawal); 'cosmic play' gloss — kept play-pomp (ḍambara as pomp, slightly gaudy).

lines: Reckon, time, the measures; creator, eagerly create;
churn, love, command-swayed — play-pomp sky-homed as it were,
in self-drawn line-trains, rest on body-and-all:
in perverse great folly's stain, what see I not?
l4.sanskrit_cite: kālaḥ saṅkalayan kalāḥ kalayatu sraṣṭā sṛjatv ādarād | ājñāyāḥ paratantratām upagato mathnātu vā manmathaḥ | krīḍāḍambara ambarāśrayam iva svollekharekhākramaṃ | dehādyāśrayam astu vaikṛtamahāmohe na paśyāmi kim

reads_against.argmap: What may play? → Cosmic permission: time, creation, desire all let be; the play abides in body; nothing unseen even in delusion's evil.
c1_essence: Time reckoned, creation created, love churning — play abiding in body; nothing unseen in delusion's evil.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta settling (wonder worked through to rest)
